category_edits.rationale: Add a fixed residual path to every GRU transition: h_t = 0.1*h_previous + 0.9*GRUCell(x_t, h_previous). This may preserve longer-lived interests while retaining widths, depth, parameter initialization, padding behavior, embeddings, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer. The generated predictor already imports GRU4RecModel from train.py, so it loads the identical recurrence and one checkpoint per category.

edits.find:
self.gru = nn.GRU(hidden_units, hidden_units, num_layers=num_layers,
                          batch_first=True, dropout=dropout)
edits.replace:
self.gru = ResidualGRU(hidden_units, hidden_units, num_layers=num_layers,
                               batch_first=True, dropout=dropout)

change_summary: Implement residual GRU transitions for all four category models, with scripted recurrent computation and matching inference through the existing predictor import. Preserve the 200-epoch default and all other training and scoring behavior.
